---
title: Static removal with every group shown
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  docx: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: veil
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
      - name: backup
        shown: false
    state: "level:2,backup"
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ["MKPLAINTEXT", "MKADVANCEDSPAN", "MKEXPERTSPAN", "MKEXPERTSECTION", "MKEXPERTSUBSECTION", "MKADVANCEDSECTION", "MKEXPERTDIV", "MKDEFAULTDIV", "MKEXPERTCALLOUT", "MKEXPERTFIGURE", "MKBACKUPTABLE", "MKEXPERTCODE", "MKADVBACKUPDIV", "MKADVANCEDOUTER", "MKEXPERTINNER"]
        - ["veil", "group="]
    docx:
      ensureDocxRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ["veil"]
---
